name: Orca
description: Buzz agents that hand each request to a coding agent in Orca, on this computer or a paired Orca server, in a workspace of your repository, and post its report back to the thread.

args:
o=""; for a in /Applications/Orca.app "$HOME/Applications/Orca.app"; do if [ -x "$a/Contents/Resources/bin/orca" ]; then o="$a/Contents/Resources/bin/orca"; break; fi; done
if [ -z "$o" ]; then a=$(/usr/bin/mdfind "kMDItemCFBundleIdentifier == 'com.stablyai.orca'" 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/head -n 1); if [ -n "$a" ] && [ -x "$a/Contents/Resources/bin/orca" ]; then o="$a/Contents/Resources/bin/orca"; fi; fi
if [ -z "$o" ]; then o=$(command -v orca 2>/dev/null); [ -x "$o" ] || o=""; fi
if [ -n "$o" ]; then exec "$o" "$@"; fi
printf '%s\n' '{"ok":false,"error":{"code":"orca_not_installed","message":"Orca is not installed on this computer. Install Orca, open it once, then try again."}}'; exit 127
